steps.description:
Create a function that takes in a 2D list and display it in columns and rows. You may also pass in any other arguments to your function if required.

Write a program that performs the following: 1. Asks user to input the row and column sizes of a 2D list separated by a space. 2. Asks user to input 2 symbols separated by space. 3. Generate a 2D list with the row and column sizes and set all the values to the first symbol. 4. Call the function to display the list. 5. Asks user to input a row index. 6. Set all the values at that row to the second symbol. 7. Call the function to display the list.

You may also pass in any other arguments to your function if required. Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Test Input 5 3 @ + 2

3 7 X $ 0

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below

Example 1 Input row size and column size: 5 3 Input 2 characters: @ + Input row: 2

Example 2 Input row size and column size: 3 7 Input 2 characters: X $ Input row: 0
